item.description: Olanipekun, Oyedele urge South-West leaders to unite and harness Tinubu’s presidency to fast-track infrastructure, industrialisation and economic growth.

item.title: Bauchi At 50: Governor Bala Mohammed Declares Tuesday Public Holiday, Urges Tree Planting
item.description: Bauchi marks 50 years with a public holiday on Tuesday as residents are urged to plant trees for environmental sustainability.
